pull_requests.title: Fix freelancer readiness and clarify employee and business routes
pull_requests.body:
A freelancer who confirmed that business profit still needed preparation could finish intake and compute an estimate, including with contradictory zero business profit. Add readable foreign eligibility questions and employee, freelancer and sole-trader discovery routes. Explain company/partnership exclusions and unsupported business/foreign-service document categories without misclassifying documents. Document an adaptive walkthrough of 15 user situations with six synthetic PDFs and 102 protocol requests, including before/after observations and remaining product gaps. This is agent-driven protocol testing, not an installed-host UI or independent human study.

pull_requests.title: Fix first-time guidance and document category recovery
pull_requests.body:
A manual, adaptive walkthrough of the compiled MCP found that a first-time user could get stuck after choosing the wrong document category, see ready intake while a document was still pending, and be advised to restart an unsaved session when saving was disabled.

Adds plain getting-started/manual-entry guidance and safe session-status booleans, explicit unsaved-work warnings, readable document labels/questions/notes, single-document reclassification with same-file verification and replacement-chain guards, and progress that prioritizes document reconciliation. Managed-category history prevents a formerly applied amount from surviving a category correction silently. Existing answers and unrelated sources remain intact.

Validation: 49 manually selected before/after protocol requests with synthetic documents; corrected category, old-year exclusion, partial OCR correction, source totals and worksheet completed with the expected sample balance. 129 tests passed, including both protocol versions, plus native PDF/OCR/encrypted-restart, installed-package, security, rule governance and contract/version checks. No tax-rule JSON or arithmetic change. Preview.13.

The walkthrough and limits are recorded in docs/first-time-walkthrough.md. This is running-MCP evaluation, not an installed desktop-host UI or independent human usability study. Official filing and practitioner approval remain outside the preview.

pull_requests.title: Add local document review, source reconciliation and encrypted drafts
pull_requests.body:
Tax users can now review selected local PDFs/images/salary CSVs, confirm extracted values, resolve duplicate/wrong-year/revised documents, and apply source-linked totals without sending raw text to the assistant. The actual compiled-MCP document journey returns the reconciled LKR 5,800 sample balance, saves an encrypted draft, restarts, restores without worksheet approval, and rejects later totals that conflict with evidence.

Adds nonmutating copied-money normalization and a case-specific checklist for work completed externally. File access and AES-256-GCM draft slots are disabled by default and require configured local roots, a private key file for drafts, current consent and explicit per-action confirmation. Updates the capability allowlist, security model, host instructions and setup documentation. No new npm dependency, tax-rule JSON or tax arithmetic change. Expiry limits restore eligibility; ciphertext deletion is explicit. Degraded OCR needs manual review, and official complete filing outputs/practitioner approval remain outside the preview.

Validation: 123 unit/protocol tests; real text-PDF, PNG and image-only-PDF OCR with confirmed corrections; revision/duplicate/year/instruction/provenance checks; encrypted restart/restore/tampering/expiry/key checks; TypeScript; rules; security; MCP contract/version; isolated installed-package legacy and modern journeys. Adds Linux CI for the native document gate.

Package: 2026.25.0-preview.12. Setup: docs/local-workflow.md.

pull_requests.title: Improve tax intake and evidence review
pull_requests.body:
Users entering salary and bank-certificate totals can review confirmed facts, answer plain-language questions without calculating scope hints, and see suspicious-credit warnings carried through the worksheet. Instalments require an explicit gross-tax source, with an opt-in Method 1 match against current prior-year preview tax. Identical normalized writes preserve worksheet acknowledgement.

Validation: 115 tests passed; TypeScript, rule governance, MCP contract/version, runtime security and isolated installed-package legacy/modern journeys passed. Tax-rule JSON and arithmetic are unchanged. Remaining evidence, draft and preparation gaps are tracked in docs/user-validation.md.

pull_requests.title: Verify production SBOM and runtime capability boundaries

CI repeats existing Node 22/24 and Linux/Windows/macOS checks. Eight new regression tests cover inventory, integrity, graph and capability changes.

These checks are review aids, not a sandbox, malicious-code detector, vulnerability scan, signature or tax-law approval. Runtime code, rules, consent, public MCP contract and private preview.10 version are unchanged. Public provenance/signing, license decisions, installed-host evaluation and source/practitioner release blockers remain pending.

pull_requests.title: Prepare private npm executable and verify installed package
pull_requests.body:
The source-only CLI works in a checkout but cannot run as an npm dependency because Node refuses TypeScript stripping inside node_modules. Add a pinned-compiler JavaScript build with rewritten imports, an executable bin entry and a restricted package file allowlist. Keep the package private and unpublished.

The package check builds and packs a real tarball, verifies its exact 24-file inventory, installs it outside the checkout in a path with spaces using production dependencies only and disabled lifecycle scripts, then exercises npm’s installed executable shim with offline registry fallback disabled. Both protocol eras verify contract/schema parity, consent, a source-example computation, rule/cage loading, checklist/worksheet, instalments, acknowledgement invalidation and wipe. No compiler, source symlink or Inspector is available to the installed consumer. CI adds Node 22/24 checks on Linux, Windows and macOS and retains private tarball/integrity artifacts for seven days.

Validation: local TypeScript checking, all 95 tests, rule governance, contract check, 22 Inspector probes and both installed-package journeys pass. Package preview.10 changes only SDK version metadata in four contract prompt responses; tool and schema content, rules, consent and filing readiness are unchanged.

This delivers private package preparation for part of T9.1. Public publishing, license/registry decisions, provenance, signed desktop bundles, installed desktop-host evaluation and source/practitioner release gates remain pending. No publish workflow or credentials are added.

pull_requests.title: Validate Inspector compatibility and guarded host workflows
pull_requests.body:

Verifier GUI acceptance, full G7 intake, remaining independent cases, official rounding and current payment-period evidence remain incomplete. These are scripted server/host regressions, not LLM behaviour certification. No payment, filing/export or publication capability is introduced.

pull_requests.title: Add pre-export checklist and cage-mapped text worksheet
pull_requests.body:
## Change

Adds `lk_get_checklist`, `lk_acknowledge_checklist` and `lk_generate_worksheet` (backlog T8.6 and part of T8.1).

- The checklist is derived from the current review. It always covers preview limits, scope and known issues, and unresolved review gaps. Credit-reconciliation and calculation-flag items appear only when credits or flags are present.
- Acknowledgement is bound to a SHA-256 digest of rule and mapping versions, cage amounts and statuses, gap codes, flags and alternatives. Any fact change, new consent, new session or wipe clears it. State is memory-only.
- The worksheet is Markdown text in cage-map order with banners, arithmetic checks, manual gaps, flags and comparison figures. Unresolved cages read "enter manually". It is refused until the current checklist is acknowledged and inherits every consent, scope and financial refusal from the review.
- No file is written, so the SECURITY.md posture is unchanged. This is not a filing export, and `export_available` on the review stays false.
- Public contract grows from 10 to 13 tools. Package version is now `2026.25.0-preview.9` and the contract snapshot is refreshed. Annual/instalment rules, cage map and consent version are unchanged. The `file_my_return` prompt describes the new steps.

Locally on Node 22: `npm run check`, `npm test` (79 tests, including the new `test/worksheet.test.ts` and both stdio journeys), `npm run rules:check`, `npm run contract:check` and `npm run contract:version -- <base-sha>` all pass. CI covers Node 24.

None. No rule values, sources or archives changed.

pull_requests.title: Add source-verified cage map and annual return review
pull_requests.body:
Adds lk_review_return to recompute a supported annual estimate and inspect cited main-return and schedule fields. A validated YA 2025/26 JSON cage map is based on the complete official return, schedules and guide, with SHA-256 digests and page locators. Eleven arithmetic checks verify income, reliefs, deductions, Schedule 8 buckets and transfers. Each engine figure has an explicit mapped, reference-only or working disposition.

The primary form confirms solar relief at cage 70 and personal relief at 80. Final dividend WHT already deducted is informational at Schedule 6A 607; it never becomes unpaid final withholding or an advance credit. Refund 200, exempt disclosures 210, gross remittances 210A and historical solar carry-forward stay unset. Credit/certificate/payment splits are not guessed from aggregates. All engine flags and alternatives remain visible, and format hints require portal confirmation.

Validation covers 64 tests, including eight review regressions, all six IRD annual examples, consent, current-fact edits, scope/financial refusals, corrupted mapping checks and both real SDK stdio journeys. CI checks TypeScript and the refreshed interface snapshot/version gate on Node 22 and 24. The temporary source capture workflow is removed.

Development review only: mapping_complete, filing_ready and export_available remain false. No files, identifiers, filings, payments or submissions are introduced. Practitioner approval, complete disclosures/credit rows, official filing rounding and the remaining golden-case release gates are still pending. Package preview.7; tax rules and consent version are unchanged. See docs/return-review.md.

pull_requests.title: Add dependency-aware tax interview and early eligibility blockers
pull_requests.body:
The annual interview now asks only for the next relevant writable facts. For example, confirming all three foreign amounts as zero skips seven irrelevant eligibility questions. Changing an amount reactivates the corresponding questions. Missing monetary amounts never default to zero, and explicit user answers remain intact.

Adds an intake-readiness graph with complete/incomplete/placeholder states, a writable fact dictionary resource, early scope/unsupported/foreign eligibility blockers and fixed referral guidance. A placeholder never includes a provisional tax amount; complete intake still passes through the existing financial validations. Scope and foreign predicates are shared with computation. Neutral booleans for proven-inapplicable branches exist only in a computation input and are identified separately from actual user answers in intake_context.

Validation covers 56 tests: all existing annual and instalment examples, conditional salary/service/credit questions, amount edits, no implicit zeros, early refusals, dictionary/schema parity, privacy, consent, wipe and full legacy/modern SDK journeys. Updated the reviewed interface snapshot and bumped the package to preview.6. Final CI checks TypeScript, all tests, the snapshot and version gate on Node 22 and 24.

This implements T2.2 intake dependencies. Full partial evaluation of monetary nodes, broader tax categories, filing-obligation triage, exports and practitioner sign-off remain pending. Tax rules and consent version are unchanged. See docs/interview-policy.md.

pull_requests.title: Add guided MCP workflows and versioned interface checks
pull_requests.body:
Hosts can now discover four guided workflows for annual estimates, filing-guidance limits, instalment planning and explanations. Shared instructions preserve explicit consent, privacy, scope refusals and verbatim deterministic summaries. Prompts accept no taxpayer arguments and cannot start sessions or accept consent. Added a manual evidence checklist and rule-specific source catalogue; filing-obligation decisions, ingestion and exports remain unavailable.

The server now derives its identity version from package.json. Added modern 2026-07-28 discovery and per-request metadata coverage alongside the legacy 2025-11-25 journey. A reviewed SDK-generated snapshot hashes tool schemas, descriptions, annotations, prompts, resource metadata and shared instructions. CI compares the live interface to this snapshot and rejects PR interface changes without a package version change. Snapshot updates are explicit and contain only public static metadata.

Validation: TypeScript checking and all 48 tests pass on Node 22 and 24. Initial SDK captures were byte-identical across both runtimes; final CI verifies the committed snapshot and the version gate against main. Tests cover prompt privacy, static retrieval without consent side effects, both protocol journeys and unchanged tax examples.

No tax-rule values, consent version, filing readiness or practitioner review status changes. Interactive host testing, Inspector CLI, an installed Agent Skill and the primary-verified cage map remain pending. See docs/mcp-contract.md and docs/implementation-status.md.

pull_requests.title: Add YA 2026/27 instalment planner with sourced methods and deadlines
pull_requests.body:
Adds a consent-gated, stateless instalment planner for YA 2026/27 using the IRD circular re-revised on 12 August 2026. Methods 1 and 2(i)-(iv) require a confirmed gross-tax basis prepared externally, explicit eligibility and reconciled withholding. For example, Mr X produces LKR 67,500 for quarter one; Mrs P produces zero without inferring a filing or credit-schedule exemption.

Includes SET-to-return revision guards, timely-notice checks, payment and document deadlines, correct YA metadata, source digest and cited amount traces. The superseded 6 August requirements reference is documented without modifying the original research. The temporary public-source capture workflow has been removed.

Validation: 43 engine/session tests pass locally, including all six circular arithmetic examples, every method, revisions, exact-cent arithmetic, consent and privacy. Real stdio protocol coverage is extended for planner discovery, source resources and success/error metadata; full type checking and all 44 tests run in CI on Node 22 and 24.

Development preview remains unreviewed and not filing-ready. A is not calculated by this planner. Cent ceiling is an explicit unverified rounding assumption. Foreign-credit bases, corporate tax computations, Method 3, payments and filing decisions remain unsupported. Practitioner sign-off is pending.

pull_requests.title: Add qualifying foreign income, capped credits and remaining IRD examples
pull_requests.body:
Adds confirmed qualifying foreign-employer salary and net foreign-service income in manually converted LKR, capped progressive foreign tax and eligible foreign income tax credits. Credits are limited to one confirmed source in one country, the foreign bucket tax and the statutory average-rate ceiling. Missing eligibility, remittance, conversion or credit confirmations refuse computation; no source pooling, foreign-tax refunds or unsupported carry-forward is assumed.

Implements the requirements local-first deduction allocation and local-first progressive-band stacking as explicit preview assumptions. Low-local-income results derive SC-08 and INTERP_15PCT from actual amounts and return a flat-cap comparison with independently recalculated credits and balances. Scope hints cannot suppress these flags. All new monetary figures have cited explanation traces; tool schemas, disclaimer and package versions are updated.

Validation: all 36 tests and type checks pass in GitHub CI on Node 22 and 24. Thirty-five core tests also pass locally. All six IRD worked examples now match their published balances under the documented fixture assumptions, including G2 LKR 22,000, G3 LKR 16,835,900 and G6 LKR 22,600. Tests cover eligibility refusals, exact bands, monotonicity, source pooling, average-rate cap, non-refundable excess, interpretation boundaries and updated facts. The expanded real stdio workflow verifies the official foreign-credit case, derived warnings, explanations and independently recomputed interpretation totals.

Sources: IRD YA 2025/26 guide, Schedule 8/Annexure 7, Schedule 9 and Examples 2/3/6; IRD consolidated Act sections 80-81. A source check revealed separate-source and average-rate constraints omitted from the research summary; these are now enforced and documented. The consolidated PDF timed out, but the relevant clauses were available in its official indexed text. Full amendment and practitioner review remain pending.

Rule version 2025.26.3, package 2026.25.0-preview.3. All rules remain unreviewed and all calculations retain estimate=true and filing_ready=false. Multi-country/per-source allocation, non-qualifying foreign income, automatic FX, remaining release golden cases and filing exports remain unavailable. Original requirements and backlog files are unchanged.

pull_requests.title: Add local tax reliefs and IRD Examples 4 and 5
pull_requests.body:
Extends the YA 2025/26 local-income estimate to gross investment rent, eligible solar relief balances, approved cash charity donations, Government donations with eligible carry-forward and supported Samurdhi shop contributions. Resident-company dividends with final WHT already deducted are informational, excluded from assessable income and advance credits; withholding mismatches refuse calculation.

Every new income and deduction fact requires explicit confirmation. Missing facts never default to zero. The disclaimer version and development package version are bumped. Cited traces cover all monetary figures, and new resources publish supported scenarios and known issues.

Validation: all 21 tests and type checks pass in GitHub CI on Node 22 and 24. Twenty core tests also pass locally, including primary-source IRD Examples 1, 4 and 5, with exact balances of LKR 11,200, LKR 5,910,084 and LKR 544,600. Fixtures record aggregation, G5 opening solar-balance assumptions and the source's impossible April date. Tests cover annual limits, income caps, carry-forward conservation, final-WHT exclusion, fact updates and unsupported cases. The expanded stdio workflow verifies G5, the new explanation lines, known-issues/scenario resources and the charity-cap refusal.

Sources/rules: IRD YA 2025/26 guide, Annexure 1(a)-(c), Annexure 3(a),(b),(d),(f), Annexure 4(i), Schedule 9 and Examples 4/5. Rule version 2025.26.2. Annexure 3(a)'s assessable-income and taxable-income cap language produces different deductions for some low-income charity claims; these return CHARITY_CAP_REVIEW rather than selecting an interpretation silently.

Practitioner approval remains pending. All rules remain unreviewed and every result remains an estimate with filing_ready=false. Foreign income/credits and filing exports are still unavailable. Original requirement files are unchanged.

pull_requests.title: Start local tax MCP development with consent, scope and exact estimates
pull_requests.body:
Implements the first foundation slice from the requirements: official TypeScript SDK stdio server, versioned consent, memory-only sessions, explicit missing-fact interview, SC-01 through SC-09 scope checks and a YA 2025/26 local-income estimate using bigint arithmetic. Computation rechecks current scope and refuses unsupported income or claims. Includes cited traces, identifier output checks, security documentation and implementation tracking.

Validation: type checking and all 11 tests passed in GitHub CI on Node 22 and 24, including a real stdio protocol journey. Core tests cover IRD Example 1 with LKR 11,200 balance, progressive-band boundaries, monotonicity, consent/scope invalidation and privacy regressions, including SDK validation-error sanitisation. The dependency lock was captured from the successful CI install, verified against the artifact SHA-256 and committed. CI now uses npm ci.

This is not the complete P0 release. Foreign income, filing-obligation triage, additional reliefs, ingestion, instalments, persistence and exports remain unavailable. The package stays private and every result is an unreviewed estimate with filing_ready=false. The status document records remaining acceptance criteria and corrects the research note about Annexure 7's foreign-income table. No original requirement documents are changed.

Rule source: IRD YA 2025/26 guide, Annexure 1(a), Annexure 7, Schedule 9 and Example 1. Qualified practitioner approval remains pending; do not merge as reviewed tax rules or publish for filing.
